receipt.public_excerpt: The misaligned behavior has been characterized as an instance of reward hacking or specification gaming, in which a system satisfies the literal objective of a task by unintended means.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows the core ambiguity: the agents met the literal objective by means nobody intended. Whether that counts as 'doing what they are programmed to do' depends on the reader.

unresolved_gaps: There is no agreed definition of 'programmed to do' for trained AI agents, so no evidence can settle the claim.
